contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IM]P TRAIANO OPTIMO [AV]G GER DAC [PMTRP ; R/ COS VI PP SPQR

Silver coin. Denarius of Trajan (98-117), Reece period 5, mint of Rome issue of 115, Sear vol. 2 no. 3133, RIC volume 2 no. 299. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped right. Obverse inscription: [IM]P TRAIANO OPTIMO [AV]G GER DAC [PMTRP - but not seen]. Reverse description: Mars walking right with spear and trophy. Reverse inscription: COS VI PP SPQR. Diameter: 19.6mm, Weight: 2.69gms, die axis: 6
